Method of Attack: Spoofing vulnerability in Service Fabric Explorer allowing attackers with deployer permissions to create malicious application names and abuse administrator permissions to perform cluster node reset and gain full administrator privileges
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerable Service Fabric Explorer web client version SFXv1 with code deployment and execution privileges
Indicators of Compromise: Proof of concept exploit available in Orca Security's blog post
Additional Notes: Microsoft states that only older unsupported SFXv1 is vulnerable; current default SFXv2 is not vulnerable. Attack requires attacker to have code deployment and execution privileges.
